description: Two sections in 2HP, each turning a button press or an incoming signal into a gate and a pair of triggers, one at the start and one at the end

params.text: Raises that section's gate while it is held, or holds it until the next press when its latch button is on
Makes the button beside it a toggle, one press taking the gate high and the next taking it low, in place of a gate that lasts while the button is held
Chooses how that section reads its input: green treats it as a gate that the output follows, red treats it as a trigger that flips the output each time one arrives

inputs.text: The signal that drives that section when its button is not pressed, read as a gate or as a trigger according to the button beside it

outputs.text: Carries 10V while that section is high and 0V while it is low
Fires a 1ms pulse at the moment that section goes high
Fires a 1ms pulse at the moment that section goes low

notes: pressing the button overrides the input for as long as it is down, so the section goes high whatever is arriving
the two trigger outputs are each 1ms high followed by 1ms low, so an input gate shorter than 1ms produces one run-together pulse downstream rather than two
menu: Set buttons 1-2: Latched, Unlatched — sets both latch buttons at once
Push-1 Polyphony, Push-2 Polyphony: 1 (monophonic) up to 16 channels — sets how many channels that section's three outputs carry, all with the same signal
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
Auto select process quality — picks the process quality from the dialled-in rate and from which ports are patched, and greys out the manual choice while it is on
Gate-high detect-level — sets the voltage at which an incoming gate counts as high, 1V or more unless you change it
Gate-high output-level — sets the voltage a gate output carries while high, 10V unless you change it
Gate-low output-level — sets the voltage a gate output carries while low, 0V unless you change it
Trigger-high detect-level — sets the voltage at which an incoming trigger counts as high, 1V or more unless you change it
Trigger-low detect-level — sets the voltage an incoming trigger must fall back below before the next one is counted, under 0.1V unless you change it
Trigger-high output-level — sets the voltage a trigger pulse carries during its 1ms high phase, 10V unless you change it
Trigger-low output-level — sets the voltage a trigger output carries between pulses, 0V unless you change it

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
